detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Every wrapper `<div class="box"><div class="inner">...` adds memory and style recalculation overhead. `contain: layout paint` tells the browser that internal layout changes will never affect external ancestors.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Design Token Layer: Primitives, semantic aliases, and component tokens established.
2. Component Architecture: Headless state and keyboard accessibility hooks implemented.
3. Styling & Cascade: Zero-runtime CSS variables and layer specificity managed.
4. Governance & Packaging: Tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and telemetry monitored.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals:
## 🏎️ DOM Node Count & CSS Containment ### 1. Eliminating DOM Wrapper Hell Instead of: ```tsx /* ❌ 4 DOM elements for a simple badge: */
Active
``` Flatten into a single semantic element: ```tsx /* ✅ 1 clean semantic DOM element: */ Active ``` ### 2. CSS `contain` Property When building complex components like Accordions, Cards, and Tables: ```css .ds-card { contain: content; /* Equivalent to: contain: layout paint style; */ } ``` This tells the browser's Blink/Gecko layout engine: *"Changes inside this card will never affect the size, layout, or paint of any element outside this card."* The browser skips recalculating the rest of the entire page layout!
